narrative.overview:
The record is a handwritten Indonesian exercise book lying on a desk: a pale grey leaf on a charcoal desk by day, a dark grey leaf on a near-black desk by night. Each entry is a leaf you turn, not a card you open. The palette is strictly neutral grey with one orange signal; light and dark are both fully designed.

Two hands share the page. Nanum Pen Script is the user's own hand: entry text, dates, wordmark and every numeral. Patrick Hand is the printed side: prompts, buttons, labels and chrome.

The book is built from physical cues in CSS: a double margin rule, a spine shadow, stacked leaves under the right and bottom edges, rules only inside writing areas, and pen-wobbled corners on every control. Nothing is a card.
keyCharacteristics: One orange (#c73e08 day, #ff6b2c night) carries action, focus, selection, caret, errors and the intensity marker.
Intensity is a marker swipe whose length is the value, with the number ringed in pen beside it.
The entry detail is a book reader with a bent-leaf page turn, shade, cast shadow and ghosted back; reduced motion swaps instantly.
Writing sits on 36px rules with no box around inputs.
A desk bar, always dark, holds navigation; the leaf holds the record.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only chroma. Everything else is neutral grey; no second accent, no status tint.

rules.name: The Chalk On The Desk Rule
rules.body: Orange does not hold against the charcoal desk by day, so controls on the desk ring their focus in chrome.

rules.name: The Edge Versus Rule Rule
rules.body: --rule is for ruled lines and hairlines; anything a finger must find uses --edge.

rules.name: The Number Beside The Colour Rule
rules.body: Marker colour only reinforces the length and the ringed number, which always carry the reading.

rules.name: The Own Hand Rule
rules.body: Anything the user wrote, and every number, is Nanum Pen Script. Anything the app says is Patrick Hand.

rules.name: The Rule Grid Rule
rules.body: Writing and prompts share a 36px line pitch so text always sits on a ruled line.

rules.name: The Book Casts, Nothing Else Rule
rules.body: Shadow belongs to the leaf and the turning leaf. Controls, fields and rows stay flat.

dos: Do keep orange to action, focus, selection, caret, error, and the intensity marker, one orange per theme.
Do set the user's words and every number in Nanum Pen Script, and the app's words in Patrick Hand.
Do write on 36px rules with no box around the field.
Do show the ringed number beside every marker swipe.
Do ring focus in chrome on the desk and in orange on the leaf.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and field text at 16px or more.
Do draw the plot only from real entry data, with shape equal to the valence the user gave.
Do keep the Google sign-in button as Google specifies it in both themes.
donts: Don't use cards, pills or uniformly rounded boxes; corners are always a little uneven.
Don't introduce a second hue or colour-code status.
Don't put a shadow on anything but the book and the turning leaf.
Don't invent plot data for empty states.
Don't set the user's writing in the print face.
Don't theme or restyle the Google button.
